header.function_name: F07 IF Cross Dock Master to AP POLE

objective: To send the cross dock master of every Active part that is waiting for synchronisation to AP POLE: Pcs/Case and Max Case/Day from the Part List (TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE) and all destinations with Case/Day of the ongoing period from the Part Mapping per Destination (TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE_DEST).
A part is sent as one complete set and replaces the data of the part in AP POLE, so a change such as Philippines up and Thailand down, or a removed destination, arrives as one consistent update.
The result is kept per part for AP POLE in TB_R_CROSSDOCK_IF_RESULT; together with the result of F06 (GTOPAS) it gives the overall Sync Status shown on the Cross Dock Part Master screen (F01).

nodes.label: Send part set to AP POLE
Write result, overall Sync Status, history, Log

extra_tables.title: Execution Schedule
rows: On demand: [Sync] on F01 (Mapping per Destination tab) starts F07 and F06. No scheduler (TBC).
Interface method to AP POLE TBC: RPA as in the first design (the target has no interface) or a system interface.
Independent of F06; both run after [Sync].

nodes.label: Replace part data in AP POLE

steps: [Sync] on F01 sets the parts to Waiting (SYNC_STATUS = '3' in TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE, IF_STATUS = '3' for 'APPOLE' and 'GTOPAS' in TB_R_CROSSDOCK_IF_RESULT) and starts F07. Write the start message (LOG1).
Select the parts with TARGET_SYSTEM = 'APPOLE' and IF_STATUS = '3' in TB_R_CROSSDOCK_IF_RESULT whose PART_STATUS is still 'Active'. Keep CHANGED_DT of each part.

steps.text: For each part, read the complete set:
children: All rows of the ongoing period (DEST_CODE, CASE_DAY) from TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE_DEST. A part without destination is sent with an empty destination list (TBC).

steps: Replace the cross dock master of the part in AP POLE with this set (destinations not in the set are removed in AP POLE). One part = one unit of work: an error stops only this part.

steps.text: Write the result of 'APPOLE' in TB_R_CROSSDOCK_IF_RESULT:
children: Success: IF_STATUS = '1', IF_DT = now, IF_MESSAGE = blank.
Failed: IF_STATUS = '2', IF_DT = now, IF_MESSAGE = reason from AP POLE. Write LOG3.

steps.text: Update the overall Sync Status of the part in TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE and record the history:
children: CHANGED_DT differs from step 2 (part changed while sending): SYNC_STATUS = '0' (No Sync).

Else, result of 'APPOLE' and of the other target in TB_R_CROSSDOCK_IF_RESULT: one still '3' -> SYNC_STATUS stays '3'; both '1' -> '1' (Success); one '2' -> '2' (Failed, SYNC_MESSAGE = target + reason).
SYNC_DT = now when SYNC_STATUS becomes 1 or 2.
Insert TB_H_PART_CANDIDATE: event SYNC, source IF, FIELD_NAME SYNC_STATUS, REMARK = 'APPOLE: ' + result / message.

steps: More Waiting parts: back to step 3.
Write the end message (LOG2) with the number of parts sent / failed. Exit.

mappings.description: Reason from AP POLE when Failed; blank when Success

destination.description: Overall Sync Status of the part

mappings.description: '0' when CHANGED_DT changed; else '3' while a target is Waiting, '1' when both Success, '2' when a target Failed
Date-time when SYNC_STATUS becomes 1 or 2; else not changed
Target + reason when Failed; blank when Success
New overall status (Waiting / Success / Failed / No Sync)

items: Source data: Part List (TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE: Pcs/Case, Max Case/Day) and Part Mapping per Destination (TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE_DEST: destinations and Case/Day of the ongoing period). Only Active parts are sent; Candidate and Inactive parts are never sent.
F07 sends to AP POLE only; F06 sends the same data to GTOPAS. The first version had one RPA for both targets.

Result per target: TB_R_CROSSDOCK_IF_RESULT (new table). Overall SYNC_STATUS in TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE: Waiting while a target is Waiting, Success when both targets are Success, Failed when one target failed (the next [Sync] sends the part again to both targets; replace is repeatable).
A part changed on F01 or by upload while it is being sent gets SYNC_STATUS = No Sync, so the newer data is sent by the next [Sync].
Interface method, AP POLE screens / fields and behaviour when AP POLE is not available: TBC.

logging_messages.message: IF cross dock master to AP POLE started. <n> part(s).
IF cross dock master to AP POLE ended. Sent <OK>, failed <NG>.
Part No <PART_NO> not accepted by AP POLE: <IF_MESSAGE>.

action.system: IF_STATUS = 2; continue with the next part.
action.user: Correct the cause and click [Sync] on F01.

logging_messages.message: AP POLE is not available: <ERROR_DETAIL>. Remaining parts stay Failed.

action.system: IF_STATUS = 2 for the remaining parts. Stop.
action.user: Click [Sync] again later; contact PIC if it persists.

tables.name: TB_R_CROSSDOCK_IF_RESULT
tables.description: New table: result of the cross dock master interface per part and target system (F06 GTOPAS, F07 AP POLE). The overall Sync Status of the part stays in TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE. Name and columns proposed.
columns: Calculation period of the mapping sent (YYYYMM)
Date-time of the result of the target system
Reason when Failed; blank when Success
User who last changed the record

tables.name: TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE
tables.description: Candidate part setting, one record per part (Part List data, no calculation period). Target of a successful upload.
columns: Minimum MAD (mandatory); reference compared with the MAD result of the calculation
Effective start date; required while the part is Candidate
Date-time of the last IF function result
Reason of the last Failed sync
Upload that last changed the record
User who last changed the record

tables.name: TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE_DEST
tables.description: Destination mapping, one record per part, calculation period and destination (Mapping per Destination data). Target of a successful upload.
columns: Calculation period, YYYYMM e.g. 202609; displayed as Sep 2026
Destination code (buyer code + PD code, 7 digits); exists in TB_M_H0125_DESTINATION (Destination Master)
User who last changed the record

tables.name: TB_H_PART_CANDIDATE
tables.description: History of every change of a crossdock part (Add / Edit by screen or upload, mapping changes, Sync results, status changes and mappings made by the calculation batches). Read by the History setting modal of Part List (index PART_NO, CREATED_DT). Proposed retention: 24 months online by CREATED_DT; a monthly housekeeping job deletes older records (period configurable in system master). To be confirmed.
columns: Calculation period YYYYMM for MAPPING / SYNC / CALC; NULL for ADD / EDIT (Part List has no period)
Upload of the change (Log); NULL when not from an upload
Destination code (7 digits) for MAPPING; NULL for other events
Changed field: PCS_CASE, MAX_CASE_DAY, MIN_MAD, PART_STATUS, EFFECTIVE_START_DATE, CASE_DAY, SYNC_STATUS
Value before the change; NULL for ADD or an added destination
Value after the change; NULL for a removed destination
Free text, e.g. SYNC_MESSAGE of a Failed sync
User who made the change (IF batch user ID for SYNC, batch user ID for BATCH)
Date and time of the change
